zh.title: 波音提交四年新合約方案 獲得SPEEA工會談判代表推薦
zh.summary: 波音公司已向代表約17,000名員工的工會提交一項新的四年期合約方案，涵蓋13,000名工程師與科學家以及約4,000名技術人員。航太專業工程人員工會於2026年7月30日宣布，經談判後將向會員推薦該方案。合約內容將由工會談判單位理事會進行討論與審議。
body: 波音公司（Boeing）已向代表約17,000名員工的工會提交一項新的四年期團體合約方案。根據工會提供的資料，該談判單位共代表約13,000名工程師與科學家，以及約4,000名技術專業人員。此項新方案的提出，標誌著雙方在合約談判程序中取得實質進展。
代表員工的航太專業工程人員工會（SPEEA）於2026年7月30日正式宣布，經過多輪談判之後，工會將向全體會員推薦並支持這項最新的合約方案。工會表示，該提議為會員提供了實質且具意義的價值，能在工作與生活平衡方面帶來真正的積極改變，並且回應了全體會員所關切的優先事項。
根據工會談判小組的說明，談判代表在協商過程中感受到了波音管理階層對其關切事項的重視，並認為波音以尊重且具合作精神的方式做出回應。工會指出，這種溝通態度代表了波音公司的真實改變，同時展現出其希望與SPEEA所代表的勞動團隊重新建立信任關係的意願。
此次提交的方案包含兩份獨立的協議草案，分別適用於專業人員單位與技術人員單位。這兩份協議將交由工會內部的談判單位理事會（BUCs）進行詳細討論與審查。雖然依據工會規則，合約的具體細節目前尚未對外公開或直接發布給普通會員，但SPEEA先前已指出，雙方在退休福利、彈性工作地點與遠距工作、強制加班上限、團體醫療保險福利以及非波音勞動力的使用等關鍵議題上皆已取得具體進展。
談判單位理事會後續將負責針對這兩項合約方案發布官方建議，並提供給全體SPEEA會員參考。依據工會規範，談判單位理事會擁有發起罷工授權投票的權力，但在目前的團體合約於2026年10月6日到期之前，依法不得發動任何罷工行動。一旦理事會完成審議並做出相應推薦，合約方案將會正式呈遞給廣大會員進行投票。

en.title: Boeing Submits Four-Year Contract Offer Endorsed by SPEEA Union Negotiators
en.summary: Boeing has submitted a new four-year contract proposal to the union representing approximately 17,000 employees, which includes 13,000 engineers and scientists alongside roughly 4,000 technical workers. On July 30, 2026, the Society of Professional Engineering Employees in Aerospace (SPEEA) announced that following negotiations, union representatives will endorse the offer to its general membership. The proposed agreement consists of two separate contracts that will be formally reviewed and evaluated by the union's Bargaining Unit Councils before being presented to members for a final vote.
body: Boeing has submitted a new four-year contract offer to the labor union representing approximately 17,000 company staff members. The bargaining group encompasses 13,000 engineers and scientists, as well as around 4,000 technical workers. The submission of this new four-year proposal marks a significant development in the collective bargaining negotiations between the aircraft manufacturer and its technical workforce.

The Society of Professional Engineering Employees in Aerospace (SPEEA), which represents the affected workforce, announced on July 30, 2026, that following extensive negotiations, the union will be endorsing the contract offer to its membership. SPEEA stated that the proposal delivers real and meaningful value to its membership, achieves positive change for work-life balance, and addresses the primary priorities expressed by union members.

According to the union's bargaining team members, representatives felt that Boeing executives genuinely heard their concerns during the negotiations and responded in a respectful and collaborative manner. SPEEA noted that this attitude reflects meaningful movement by Boeing leadership and demonstrates a sincere desire to rebuild trust with its represented employee group.

The proposed deal comprises two separate agreements tailored respectively to the professional unit and the technical unit. These two distinct offers will be presented to the union's Bargaining Unit Councils (BUCs) for formal review and internal discussion. Although union rules dictate that complete details of the offer are not immediately available to the public or individual members, SPEEA previously confirmed that key progress had been achieved regarding retirement benefits, flexible work locations and virtual work arrangements, mandatory overtime limits, group health benefits, and the company's reliance on non-Boeing labor.

The Bargaining Unit Councils are charged with formally issuing their official recommendations on the contract offers to SPEEA members. Under union governance rules, the BUCs retain the authority to call for a strike authorization vote; however, no strike action can occur until after the existing contracts expire on October 6, 2026. Once the councils conclude their review and finalize their recommendations, the agreements will be formally submitted to the general membership for review.

zh.title: 荷蘭皇家航空展示首架空中巴士A350客機塗裝
zh.summary: 荷蘭皇家航空在網路貼文中展示其首架完成塗裝的空中巴士A350-900客機。該航空公司於6月中旬公布客機名稱，並於7月中旬發布影片展示組裝過程。荷蘭皇家航空選擇以荷蘭具代表性的藝術作品為飛機命名，包括林布蘭的著名畫作《夜巡》。
body: 荷蘭皇家航空（KLM）在網路貼文中展示了其首架完成全機塗裝的空中巴士 A350-900 客機。該航空公司透過社群媒體管道發布相關動態，向外界公開該架客機的最新外觀進度。
根據發布內容，荷蘭皇家航空先於6月中旬發布貼文公布該架客機的名稱，隨後於7月中旬發布影片，記錄並展示客機的組裝過程。
在飛機命名方面，荷蘭皇家航空選擇以荷蘭具代表性的藝術作品為旗下飛機命名。其中，著名畫家林布蘭的代表作《夜巡》已被選為該航空公司的飛機名稱之一。

en.title: KLM Shows Off First Fully Painted Airbus A350-900 Aircraft
en.summary: Dutch flag carrier KLM has unveiled its first fully painted Airbus A350-900 aircraft in recent online posts. The airline initially announced the name of the widebody jet in mid-June, followed by a mid-July video post depicting the assembly process of the aircraft. KLM has established a theme of naming its aircraft after iconic Dutch artworks, selecting Rembrandt's celebrated painting The Night Watch as one of the prominent artistic works featured across its fleet.
body: Dutch flag carrier KLM has showcased its very first fully painted Airbus A350-900 aircraft across recent online updates, giving observers a clear view of the new long-haul jet.
The airline first released a post in mid-June to reveal the official name assigned to the jet. Later in mid-July, KLM shared a video post documenting the detailed assembly process of the aircraft.

KLM has adopted a convention of naming its aircraft after iconic Dutch artworks. Under this theme, Rembrandt's famous painting The Night Watch was selected as one of the celebrated works to name its fleet.

zh.title: 漢莎技術於短程空中巴士A319測試新一代AeroSHARK貼膜
zh.summary: 漢莎技術宣佈已開始於漢莎城市航空的一架空中巴士A319短程客機上，測試新一代AeroSHARK節能表面貼膜技術。本次測試與合作夥伴Surventis共同執行，在發動機外罩與機身貼上約70塊透明貼膜，監測其耐用度與性能，為未來將該技術應用於承受更高氣動力負荷的機翼與尾翼收集資料。
body: 漢莎技術公司已正式宣布，開始在一架短程客機上測試新一代AeroSHARK節能表面貼膜技術，這標誌著該項鯊魚皮仿生材料首次在長程航線之外進行飛行測試。本次研究測試使用漢莎城市航空（Lufthansa City Airlines）旗下的一架空中巴士A319客機，國籍標誌暨登記號碼為D-ABGK，該機主要執飛德國慕尼黑與漢堡之間的定期航班，整體測試計畫預計將持續執行至2027年2月。
這項測試計畫是由漢莎技術與研發合作夥伴Surventis（前身為巴斯夫塗料 BASF Coatings）共同合作開展。為了在正常的商業航班營運過程中收集實際飛行資料，技術團隊在該架客機的發動機外罩內外兩側，以及機身特定區域，貼上了約70塊尺寸為20乘20公分的透明測試貼膜。
本次研究階段的核心目標，在於評估貼膜材料在日常航班營運中的耐用度與性能表現。這70塊測試貼膜在材料與層疊結構組合上有所差異，旨在找出兼具最佳耐磨損性能且易於黏貼、清潔與無殘膠剝離的最佳材質組合。團隊希望藉由相關資料，為未來將該技術推廣應用至機翼、水平尾翼及垂直尾翼等承受比機身更高氣動力負荷的結構表面奠定基礎。
AeroSHARK技術採用高度僅約50微米的微觀溝槽結構，能精確順應氣流方向以降低飛行中的氣動力阻力，目前每趟航班可減少約百分之一的燃料消耗與二氧化碳排放量。截至2026年7月，漢莎航空集團已在旗下四家航空公司共22架長程客機上安裝此技術，漢莎技術也將在該架空中巴士A319客機停靠漢堡地面維護期間進行定期檢查。

en.title: Lufthansa Technik Tests Next-Gen AeroSHARK Film on Short-Haul Airbus A319
en.summary: Lufthansa Technik has initiated flight testing of a next-generation version of its AeroSHARK fuel-saving surface technology on an Airbus A319 short-haul aircraft operated by Lufthansa City Airlines. Conducted in partnership with Surventis, the flight trial features approximately 70 transparent film patches applied to the aircraft's engine cowlings and fuselage. The monitoring process, scheduled through February 2027, aims to evaluate material durability and application methods, supporting future technical development to enable the riblet technology to be used on aircraft wings and flight control surfaces subject to higher aerodynamic loads.
body: Lufthansa Technik has officially commenced testing of a next-generation AeroSHARK fuel-saving surface technology on a short-haul commercial aircraft, marking the initial trial of the material outside of long-haul operations. The flight testing is being conducted on an Airbus A319 operated by Lufthansa City Airlines, registered under tail number D-ABGK, which operates regular flights on the domestic route between Munich and Hamburg. The testing period is scheduled to run through February 2027.

The research project is conducted in collaboration with development partner Surventis, formerly known as BASF Coatings. To gather operational data during standard commercial service, technicians have applied approximately 70 transparent film patches, each measuring 20 by 20 centimeters, to both the interior and exterior sides of the aircraft's engine cowlings as well as designated surface areas on the fuselage.

This research phase focuses on assessing material performance and durability under routine flight operations. The 70 test patches incorporate variations in material structure and layer composition to determine which combination delivers optimal resistance to wear while remaining simple to apply, clean, and remove without leaving residue. The ultimate development objective is to produce material variants suitable for application on aircraft wings and vertical and horizontal stabilizers, which experience significantly higher aerodynamic loads than fuselage surfaces.

AeroSHARK utilizes a riblet structure featuring microscopic grooves approximately 50 micrometers high, designed to align with airflow and reduce aerodynamic drag during flight, yielding fuel consumption and carbon dioxide emission reductions of roughly 1% per flight. As of July 2026, the Lufthansa Group has installed the technology on 22 long-haul aircraft across four group airlines, and Lufthansa Technik is conducting regular inspections during ground maintenance stops in Hamburg as the short-haul test progresses.

zh.title: 土耳其KAAN原型機P1完成首次低速滑行測試
zh.summary: 土耳其航太於2026年7月31日發布影片，證實第五代戰鬥機KAAN的P1原型機已於安卡拉設施完成首次低速地面滑行測試。P1與P2為承擔主要飛行測試任務的新建造機身，先前發布的P0測試機則已轉為地面與系統測試。執行長表示P1預計將於數月內進行首飛。
body: 土耳其航太於2026年7月31日發布最新影片，展示第五代戰鬥機KAAN的P1原型機於其位於安卡拉的設施完成首次地面滑行測試。在本次低速滑行測試中，該架原型機依靠自身動力於地面移動，標誌著該型戰機在地面測試階段取得的新進展。
KAAN P1原型機與另一架P2原型機，是土耳其航太特別建造用以承擔第五代戰鬥機主要飛行測試任務的兩架新機身。這兩架原型機先前於2026年2月13日在安卡拉首次公開亮相，其設計與研發過程均充分參考並融合了先前驗證機飛行測試時所獲得的反饋資料。
土耳其航太總裁兼執行長Mehmet Demiroglu於2026年7月20日至24日舉行的法恩堡國際航空展期間透露，在完成多項地面與系統層級測試後，P1原型機預計將於未來數月內進行首次飛行。此外，P2原型機預計會在2026年底前跟進首飛，屆時兩架原型機計畫於年底前實現共同飛行。
在P1與P2推出之前，該計畫首架飛行驗證機代號為P0。P0原型機於2023年3月進行跑道與滑行試驗，並於2024年完成兩次飛行測試。其中於2024年5月6日的第二次飛行中，該機空中停留時間達14分鐘，飛行高度達到10,000英呎。在完成基本飛行特性與飛控系統驗證後，P0目前已轉為執行地面與系統層級測試。
AeroTime報導指出，隨著KAAN計畫持續推進地面測試，P1原型機完成首次滑行測試後，相關團隊將依計畫完成各項系統驗證，為即將到來的首飛階段進行準備。

en.title: Turkey KAAN Fighter Prototype P1 Completes First Taxi Test
en.summary: Turkish Aerospace released footage on July 31, 2026, showing the KAAN P1 fighter prototype completing its first low-speed taxi test under its own power at the company facility in Ankara. As one of two new airframes built to carry the primary flight test campaign alongside P2, the aircraft was developed using flight feedback from the initial P0 demonstrator. Company leadership stated that P1 is expected to make its inaugural flight within the next couple of months, followed by P2 before the end of 2026.
body: Turkish Aerospace released video footage on July 31, 2026, showing the KAAN P1 fighter prototype completing its first taxi test at the company facility in Ankara. During the low-speed test, the prototype moved under its own power on the runway, representing a key milestone in ground testing for the aircraft program.

The P1 prototype, together with the P2 prototype, represents one of two new airframes built by Turkish Aerospace to handle the bulk of the fifth-generation fighter jet flight test campaign. Both P1 and P2 were publicly displayed in Ankara on February 13, 2026, and were developed incorporating feedback gathered from earlier demonstrator test flights.

Speaking at the Farnborough International Airshow held from July 20 to 24, 2026, Turkish Aerospace president and CEO Mehmet Demiroglu stated that P1 is expected to make its first flight within the next couple of months pending completion of ground and system-level tests. He added that P2 is scheduled to follow before the end of 2026, with both airframes flying alongside each other by year-end.

Prior to the assembly of P1 and P2, the program relied on the initial demonstrator designated P0 to validate basic flight characteristics and flight control systems. P0 carried out runway and taxi trials in March 2023 and completed two flights in 2024, including a May 6 flight where it remained airborne for 14 minutes and reached an altitude of 10,000 feet. The P0 airframe has since been reassigned to ongoing ground and system-level testing.

As AeroTime reported, the completion of the first taxi test by the KAAN P1 prototype advances the test schedule as Turkish Aerospace prepares the fifth-generation fighter for its upcoming flight testing phase.
